component.name: Anixart Arch
component.summary: Unofficial native Linux desktop client for Anixart

description.p: Anixart is an independent Linux desktop client implemented from scratch. It does not contain or execute the Android APK and is not affiliated with Anixart.
Consolidates Home, release details and playback selection into one-window navigation, fixes Discover wrapper IDs, and constrains poster/detail artwork for desktop layouts.
Defaults GTK to the OpenGL renderer on Wayland when no renderer override is set, fixing costly Vulkan-to-GL DMABUF fallback during fractional-scale fullscreen provider video.
Adds WebKit hardware acceleration, GTK GraphicsOffload hints and VA-API media diagnostics.
Fixes gtk4/webkit6 settings-method ambiguity during compilation.
Improves embedded-provider playback with MediaSource, WebKit media compatibility settings, a real base URI and diagnostics.
Adds native WebKitGTK iframe playback and automatic mpv/provider routing.
Adds voiceover, player-source and episode navigation with mpv/browser playback.
Initial native GTK4 proof of concept.
